SELECT * FROM (
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT '${PAGE_DATE_STATUS03}' statusValid, T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID busiCode,
T1.PS cashType,
fprod_type.TYPE_6 as assetType, T4.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, T4.FINPROD_NAME finprodMarketName,
T1.CHL_ID chlId, TC4.FINPROD_NAME channelName,
T1.VDATE vdateProd, T1.MDATE mdateProd,
T1.TRADE_DATE tradeDate,
T3.REMAIN_PRIN_AMT remainPrinAmt, T3.THEORY_AMT fpriceAmt,
T1.FPRICE_AMT TRADE_AMT,
null adjustDate, T1.WORKFLOW_ID workflowId, null pTradeId FROM WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T1
LEFT JOIN WFL_PA_TRD_FIN_DEAL_TOTAL T3 ON T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T3.TOTLE_TRADE_ID
LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T4 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T4.FINPROD_ID
LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT TC4 ON T1.CHL_ID = TC4.FINPROD_ID
LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fprod_type on fprod_type.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID WHERE T4.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TGF07} AND IFNULL(T1.IS_OVERDUE_DEAL,#{YESNO_N}) = #{YESNO_N} and T1.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS01} AND T1.P_TOTLE_TRADE_ID is null
AND (T1.PORTFOLIO_ID IS NULL or T1.PS = #{PS_T38} or T1.PS = #{PS_C7})
AND T1.P_TRADE_ID IS NULL AND T1.P_TOTLE_TRADE_ID IS NULL AND EXISTS( select 1 from WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL DEAL where (DEAL.P_TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID or deal.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = t1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID) and (DEAL.PORTFOLIO_ID OR T1.PORTFOLIO_ID )
and (DEAL.PORTFOLIO_ID IN
#{item}
OR T1.PORTFOLIO_ID IN
#{item} )
)
ORDER BY T1.MDATE DESC )
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM ( select '${PAGE_DATE_STATUS01}' statusValid, null busiCode, group_concat(t8.CASH_TYPE order by t8.CASH_TYPE separator ',') cashType,
fprod_type.TYPE_6 as assetType, t10.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, t10.FINPROD_NAME finprodMarketName,
t8.SEC_ACCT_ID chlId, TC4.FINPROD_NAME channelName,
min(t9.VDATE) vdateProd, t8.MDATE mdateProd, null tradeDate, t8.qty remainPrinAmt, SUM(t8.fpriceAmt) fpriceAmt, null TRADE_AMT, t8.PAY_DATE adjustDate, null workflowId, null pTradeId from ( select T7.FINPROD_ID, t7.CASH_TYPE, t7.CASH_ID, t7.MDATE, sum(t7.QTY) qty, sum(t7.fpriceAmt) fpriceAmt, sum(IFNULL(t7.prinAmt,0)) prinAmt, sum(t7.intAmt) intAmt,
t7.SEC_ACCT_ID, t7.PAY_DATE from ( select T1.FINPROD_ID, T1.AMOUNT * IFNULL(T1.FACE_VALUE, 1) QTY, T1.CASH_TYPE, T1.CASH_ID, T1.MDATE, T1.CDATE, CASE WHEN T1.CASH_TYPE IN ('01', '04') then T1.THORY_INT_AMT else (T1.PRIN_AMT / T1.CASH_BASEAMT) * T1.AMOUNT * IFNULL(T1.FACE_VALUE, 1) + T1.THORY_INT_AMT end fpriceAmt, CASE WHEN T1.CASH_TYPE IN ('01', '04') then 0 else (T1.PRIN_AMT / T1.CASH_BASEAMT) * T1.AMOUNT * IFNULL(T1.FACE_VALUE, 1) end prinAmt, T1.PORTFOLIO_ID, T1.SEC_ACCT_ID, T1.THORY_INT_AMT intAmt, T1.PAY_DATE FROM ( select * from ( SELECT T1.AMOUNT, t1.finprod_id, t1.sec_acct_id, t1.cdate, t6.cash_type, T6.CASH_ID, T6.MDATE, T6.CASH_AMT,T1.PORTFOLIO_ID, T6.CASH_BASEAMT, T1.FACE_VALUE, T6.PRIN_AMT, T6.INT_AMT, T6.PAY_DATE, case when t6.cash_type IN ('01', '04') then IFNULL(PSV.TDY_INTINCEXP, t6.INT_AMT*T1.AMOUNT * IFNULL(T1.FACE_VALUE, 1)/T6.CASH_BASEAMT) WHEN T6.CASH_TYPE IN ('02', '03') AND T6.INT_AMT is not null and T6.INT_AMT != 0 AND PSV.SHARE_AMT is not null THEN ROUND(T6.PRIN_AMT * T1.AMOUNT/T6.CASH_BASEAMT * PSV.TDY_INTINCEXP/PSV.SHARE_AMT, 2) else t6.INT_AMT * T1.AMOUNT* IFNULL(T1.FACE_VALUE, 1)/t6.CASH_BASEAMT end THORY_INT_AMT, IF( @finprod_id = t6.finprod_id,@rank := @rank + 1,@rank :=1 ) AS rank from ( select @rank :=0,@finprod_id := NULL )b,PTL_SEC_POSITION T1 INNER JOIN FIN_CASH_PLAN T6 on t1.cdate < t6.mdate and t1.finprod_id=t6.finprod_id INNER JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on T1.PORTFOLIO_ID = pp.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_SEC_VALUTION PSV ON T6.MDATE = PSV.CDATE + 1 AND T1.PORTFOLIO_ID = PSV.PORTFOLIO_ID AND T1.FINPROD_ID = PSV.FINPROD_ID AND PSV.INV_AIM = '999999' where IFNULL(pp.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID,'null') = 'null' and T6.PAY_DATE >= #{PLATEFORM_DATE}
and T1.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}
AND T1.HODING_TYPE = #{POSITION_TYPE03} AND T6.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TGF07} and T1.AMOUNT > 0 AND T1.PORTFOLIO_ID
AND T1.PORTFOLIO_ID IN
#{item}
and NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL tfpdt where tfpdt.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS01} and tfpdt.IS_CANCEL = #{YESNO_N} AND (tfpdt.CHL_ID = T1.SEC_ACCT_ID OR (T1.SEC_ACCT_ID = '999999' and tfpdt.CHL_ID is null)) AND T1.PORTFOLIO_ID =tfpdt.PORTFOLIO_ID AND t1.finprod_id=tfpdt.FINPROD_ID and T6.MDATE = tfpdt.MDATE ) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL tfpdt where tfpdt.WORKFLOW_STATUS = #{STATUS_A} AND T1.FINPROD_ID=TFPDT.FINPROD_ID AND (tfpdt.CHL_ID = T1.SEC_ACCT_ID OR (T1.SEC_ACCT_ID = '999999' and tfpdt.CHL_ID is null)) AND T1.PORTFOLIO_ID =tfpdt.PORTFOLIO_ID and T6.MDATE >= tfpdt.MDATE )
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION tpsp where tpsp.HODING_TYPE = #{POSITION_TYPE03} and tpsp.PORTFOLIO_ID = T1.PORTFOLIO_ID and tpsp.SEC_ACCT_ID = T1.SEC_ACCT_ID and tpsp.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID and tpsp.CDATE > T1.CDATE and tpsp.CDATE < T6.MDATE ) ) where rank = 1 order by t6.finprod_id,t6.mdate ) T1 ) T7 group by T7.FINPROD_ID, t7.CASH_TYPE, t7.CASH_ID, t7.MDATE, t7.SEC_ACCT_ID, t7.PAY_DATE ) T8
LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_PLAN T9 ON T8.CASH_ID = T9.CASH_ID AND T8.MDATE = T9.MDATE
INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T10 ON T10.FINPROD_ID = T8.FINPROD_ID AND T10.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TGF07}
LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT TC4 ON TC4.FINPROD_ID = T8.SEC_ACCT_ID
LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fprod_type on fprod_type.FINPROD_ID = T10.FINPROD_ID
T8.PAY_DATE >= #{PLATEFORM_DATE}
AND t10.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{finprodMarketId}
AND t8.CASH_TYPE = #{cashTypeC}
AND t8.MDATE >= STR_TO_DATE(#{mdateProdStart}, '%Y-%m-%d')
AND t8.MDATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{mdateProdEnd}, '%Y-%m-%d')
AND t8.SEC_ACCT_ID = #{chlId}
GROUP BY
t10.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, t10.FINPROD_NAME,
t8.SEC_ACCT_ID, TC4.FINPROD_NAME,
t8.MDATE, t8.qty, t8.PAY_DATE, fprod_type.TYPE_6 ORDER BY T8.MDATE )
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT '${PAGE_DATE_STATUS05}' statusValid, T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID busiCode, T1.PS cashType,
fprod_type.TYPE_6 as assetType, T4.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, T4.FINPROD_NAME finprodMarketName,
T1.CHL_ID chlId, TC4.FINPROD_NAME channelName,
T1.VDATE vdateProd, T1.MDATE mdateProd, T1.TRADE_DATE TRADE_DATE,
T3.REMAIN_PRIN_AMT remainPrinAmt, T3.THEORY_AMT fpriceAmt,
T1.FPRICE_AMT TRADE_AMT,
null adjustDate, null workflowId, null pTradeId FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T1
LEFT JOIN PA_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T3 ON T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T3.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T4 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T4.FINPROD_ID
LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT TC4 ON T1.CHL_ID = TC4.FINPROD_ID
LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fprod_type on fprod_type.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID WHERE T1.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS01} AND IFNULL(T1.IS_OVERDUE_DEAL,#{YESNO_N}) = #{YESNO_N} AND T1.IS_CANCEL = #{YESNO_N} AND T1.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TGF07} AND T1.P_TOTLE_TRADE_ID is null AND EXISTS( select 1 from TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL DEAL where (DEAL.P_TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID or deal.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = t1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID) and (DEAL.PORTFOLIO_ID OR T1.PORTFOLIO_ID )
and (DEAL.PORTFOLIO_ID IN
#{item}
OR T1.PORTFOLIO_ID IN
#{item} )
)
ORDER BY T1.MDATE DESC )
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT '${PAGE_DATE_STATUS06}' statusValid, T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID busiCode, T1.PS cashType,
fprod_type.TYPE_6 as assetType, T4.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, T4.FINPROD_NAME finprodMarketName,
T1.CHL_ID chlId, TC4.FINPROD_NAME channelName,
T1.VDATE vdateProd, T1.MDATE mdateProd, T1.TRADE_DATE TRADE_DATE,
T3.REMAIN_PRIN_AMT remainPrinAmt, T3.THEORY_AMT fpriceAmt,
T1.FPRICE_AMT TRADE_AMT,
null adjustDate, null workflowId, T1.P_TRADE_ID pTradeId FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T1
LEFT JOIN PA_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T3 ON T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T3.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T4 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T4.FINPROD_ID
LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT TC4 ON T1.CHL_ID = TC4.FINPROD_ID
LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fprod_type on fprod_type.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID WHERE T1.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS03} AND IFNULL(T1.IS_OVERDUE_DEAL,#{YESNO_N}) = #{YESNO_N} AND T1.IS_CANCEL = #{YESNO_N} AND T1.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TGF07} AND T1.P_TOTLE_TRADE_ID is null
AND EXISTS( select 1 from TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL DEAL where (DEAL.P_TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID or deal.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = t1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID) and (DEAL.PORTFOLIO_ID OR T1.PORTFOLIO_ID )
and (DEAL.PORTFOLIO_ID IN
#{item}
OR T1.PORTFOLIO_ID IN
#{item} )
) ORDER BY T1.MDATE DESC )
)

select pr.FINPROD_ID finprodId, pr.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, pr.FINPROD_ABBR finprodName, pr.CCY ccy, fpt.TYPE_6 assetType, pr.VDATE vdate, pr.MDATE mdate,
fcp.VDATE vdateProd,
fccr.BASIS basis, pr.ENTRUSTER entruster, fccr.YIELD*100 loadRate, fccr_2.YIELD*100 yield, fci.CASH_ID cashId, fcpr.PAY_CYCLE, fcpr.DAY_VALUE, fcpr.PAY_MONTH from FIN_PRODUCT pr
left join FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt on fpt.FINPROD_ID = pr.FINPROD_ID
left join FIN_CASH_INFO fci on fci.FINPROD_ID = pr.FINPROD_ID and fci.CASH_TYPE_1 = #{CASH_TYPE_1_02} and fci.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{CASH_TYPE_2_C02} inner join FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE fccr on fccr.CASH_ID = fci.CASH_ID
and fccr.EFF_DATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{mdateProd},'%Y-%m-%d')
and not EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE fccrt_1 where fccrt_1.EFF_DATE>fccr.EFF_DATE and fccrt_1.CASH_ID = fccr.CASH_ID
and fccrt_1.EFF_DATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{mdateProd},'%Y-%m-%d')
)
left join FIN_CASH_INFO fci_2 on fci_2.FINPROD_ID = pr.FINPROD_ID and fci_2.CASH_TYPE_1 = #{CASH_TYPE_1_03} and fci_2.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{CASH_TYPE_2_C08} inner join FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE fccr_2 on fccr_2.CASH_ID = fci_2.CASH_ID
and fccr_2.EFF_DATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{mdateProd},'%Y-%m-%d')
and not EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE fccrt_2 where fccrt_2.EFF_DATE>fccr_2.EFF_DATE and fccrt_2.CASH_ID = fccr_2.CASH_ID
and fccrt_2.EFF_DATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{mdateProd},'%Y-%m-%d')
)
left join FIN_CASH_PLAN fcp on fcp.CASH_ID = fci.CASH_ID
and STR_TO_DATE(#{mdateProd},'%Y-%m-%d') >= fcp.VDATE and fcp.MDATE > STR_TO_DATE(#{mdateProd},'%Y-%m-%d')
and #{PLATEFORM_DATE} >= fcp.VDATE and fcp.MDATE > #{PLATEFORM_DATE}
left join FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE fcpr on fcpr.CASH_ID = fci.CASH_ID
pr.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{finprodMarketId}

select psp.AMOUNT resiPrincipal from PTL_SEC_POSITION psp inner join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_ID=psp.FINPROD_ID and fp.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPRODTYPE2_F07} and fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{finprodMarketId} where psp.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId} AND PSP.SEC_ACCT_ID = #{chlId} and psp.CDATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{mdateProd},'%Y-%m-%d') and not exists( select 1 from PTL_SEC_POSITION temp where temp.PORTFOLIO_ID = psp.PORTFOLIO_ID and temp.FINPROD_ID = psp.FINPROD_ID and temp.CDATE> psp.CDATE AND temp.CDATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{mdateProd},'%Y-%m-%d') )

select psp.AMOUNT resiPrincipal from PTL_SEC_POSITION psp inner join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_ID=psp.FINPROD_ID and fp.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPRODTYPE2_F07} and fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{finprodMarketId} where psp.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId} and psp.HODING_TYPE = #{hodingType} and psp.CDATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{mdateProd},'%Y-%m-%d') and not exists( select 1 from PTL_SEC_POSITION temp where temp.PORTFOLIO_ID = psp.PORTFOLIO_ID and temp.FINPROD_ID = psp.FINPROD_ID and temp.CDATE> psp.CDATE AND temp.CDATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{mdateProd},'%Y-%m-%d') )

select psv.TDY_INTINCEXP IN_TDY_INTINCEXP from PTL_SEC_VALUTION psv inner join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_ID=psv.FINPROD_ID and fp.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPRODTYPE2_F07} and fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = #{finprodMarketId} where psv.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId} and psv.CDATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{mdateProd},'%Y-%m-%d') and not exists( select 1 from PTL_SEC_VALUTION temp where temp.PORTFOLIO_ID = psv.PORTFOLIO_ID and temp.FINPROD_ID = psv.FINPROD_ID and temp.CDATE> psv.CDATE AND temp.CDATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{mdateProd},'%Y-%m-%d') )

choose.when:
SELECT #{statusValid} statusValid, T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID busiCode, T1.CCY, T3.PA_BUSS_TYPE, T1.PS cashType, T1.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, actPortfolioInfo.PORTFOLIO_ID actPortfolioId, T2.PORTFOLIO_NAME,
sci.ACCT_NAME secManageAcctId,
T1.CHL_ID chlId, TC4.FINPROD_NAME channelName,
FPD.COLLECT_TYPE collectType, T1.FEE_AMT - IFNULL(T5.FEE_AMT, 0) channelFee, IFNULL(T1.FPRICE_AMT,T1.TRADE_AMT) tradeAmtReal, CASE WHEN T1.CHL_ID IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END channel,
fprod_type.TYPE_6 assetType, T1.FINPROD_ID, T4.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, T4.FINPROD_NAME finprodMarketName, T1.VDATE vdateProd, T1.MDATE mdateProd, fccr.BASIS, T4.VDATE, T4.MDATE, T4.ENTRUSTER, T3.RATE*100 earlyWithdrawalRate,
fccr.YIELD*100 yield,
T5.FEE_AMT,
T3.THEORY_INT, T3.THEORY_AMT fpriceAmt,
T3.REMAIN_PRIN_AMT remainPrinAmt,
T3.THEORY_PRIN earlyWithdrawalAmt, T1.INT_AMT, T1.TRADE_AMT, T1.TRADE_DATE tradeDate, fccrt_2.YIELD*100 loadRate, tdta.INT_SETT_TYPE, T1.IS_CLEAN FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T1 LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO T2 ON T2.PORTFOLIO_ID = T1.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN PA_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T3 ON T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T3.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T4 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T4.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL T5 on T5.TRADE_ID = T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID
LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT TC4 ON T1.CHL_ID = TC4.FINPROD_ID
LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD FPD ON TC4.FINPROD_ID=FPD.FINPROD_ID
LEFT JOIN PTL_CAPACCT_INFO ptl_ci on ptl_ci.PORTFOLIO_ID = T1.PORTFOLIO_ID and ptl_ci.ACCT_TYPE = #{ACCT_TYPE_A01} LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO sci on sci.ACCT_NO = ptl_ci.ACCT_NO
LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fprod_type on fprod_type.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID
LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO fcinfo on fcinfo.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID and fcinfo.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{CASH_TYPE_2_C08}
LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE fccr on fccr.CASH_ID = fcinfo.CASH_ID and fccr.EFF_DATE <= T1.MDATE and not EXISTS ( select 1 from FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE fccr2 where fccr2.CASH_ID =fccr.CASH_ID and fccr2.EFF_DATE > fccr.EFF_DATE and fccr2.EFF_DATE <= T1.MDATE )
LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO fcinfo2 on fcinfo2.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID and fcinfo2.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{CASH_TYPE_2_C02}
LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE fccrt_2 on fccrt_2.CASH_ID = fcinfo2.CASH_ID and fccrt_2.EFF_DATE <= T1.MDATE and not EXISTS ( select 1 from FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE fccr_2 where fccr_2.CASH_ID =fccrt_2.CASH_ID and fccr_2.EFF_DATE > fccrt_2.EFF_DATE and fccr_2.EFF_DATE <= T1.MDATE ) LEFT JOIN ( select pt.PORTFOLIO_ID, tpd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID from PTL_TRADE pt left join PTL_PORTFOLIO PP ON PT.PORTFOLIO_ID = PP.PORTFOLIO_ID left join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tpd on tpd.TRADE_ID = pt.BUSI_NO where PP.INVEST_YESORNO = #{YESNO_Y} and tpd.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS01} ) actPortfolioInfo on actPortfolioInfo.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID left join TRD_DEAL_TOTAL_ADD tdta on tdta.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID WHERE T1.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TGF07}
and T1.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS01}
and T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{busiCode}
and T1.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS01} and T1.IS_CANCEL = #{YESNO_Y} and T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{pTradeId}
choose.otherwise:
select #{statusValid} statusValid, group_concat(t8.CASH_TYPE order by t8.cash_id separator ',') cashType, group_concat(t8.CASH_ID separator order by t8.CASH_ID ',') cashId, t10.CCY, t8.FINPROD_ID, t8.PORTFOLIO_ID, t12.PORTFOLIO_NAME, sci.ACCT_NAME secManageAcctId,
t8.SEC_ACCT_ID chlId, TC10.FINPROD_NAME channelName,
FPD.COLLECT_TYPE collectType, null channelFee, sum(t8.fpriceAmt) tradeAmtReal, CASE WHEN (t8.SEC_ACCT_ID IS NULL OR t8.SEC_ACCT_ID='999999') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END channel,
fprod_type.TYPE_6 as assetType, t10.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, t10.FINPROD_NAME finprodMarketName, min(t9.VDATE) vdateProd, t8.MDATE mdateProd, t10.VDATE, t10.MDATE, fccr.BASIS basis, t10.ENTRUSTER,
fccrt_2.YIELD*100 loadRate,
fccr.YIELD*100 yield,
null feeAmt,
t8.qty remainPrinAmt,
sum(t8.fpriceAmt) fpriceAmt, sum(t8.fpriceAmt) tradeAmt,
